exposure: Type of suture thread used for intradermal suture (poliglecaprone 25 vs. nylon)
cohort: 60 women undergoing their first cesarean section
finding: Intradermal suture with poliglecaprone 25 for skin closure after cesarean incision resulted in better aesthetic outcomes, with significantly less hypertrophic, thinner, and more acceptable color scars compared to nylon sutures.
